=.name: Shallow Water
=.blockReason: The shallow waters are too deep to wade without a vessel.

M.name: High Mountains
M.blockReason: Impassable mountain peaks tower above you.

L.name: Locked Iron Door
L.blockReason: Barred iron door! Press [O] to Pick Lock / Use Key, or cast Arcane Knock.

triggers.name: Town of Oakhaven
triggers.message: You stand before the gates of Oakhaven, capital of Avalon. Press [E] or click Enter to step inside.

triggers.name: Castle Avalon
triggers.message: The banners of Castle Avalon flutter overhead. Press [E] to enter the royal courtyard.

triggers.name: Forest Town of Yew
triggers.message: Ancient oaks arch over the entrance to Yew. Press [E] to enter the forest town.

triggers.name: Coastal Port of Moon
triggers.message: Salt spray rises from the harbor of Moon. Press [E] to enter the port town.

triggers.name: Cavern of Despise
triggers.message: Freezing mist pours from the 8-floor Cavern of Despise (Recommended Lv 2–9). Press [E] to descend into the dark!

triggers.name: Abyss of Doom
triggers.message: Sulfurous smoke billows from the 12-floor Abyss of Doom (Recommended Lv 5–14+). Press [E] to enter the citadel!

triggers.name: Shrine of Valor (Sanctuary Isle)
triggers.message: An ancient monolith of crimson granite rises above Sanctuary Isle. Press [E] to kneel for the Blessing of Valor (+1 STR, +4 Max HP to all party heroes).

triggers.name: Shrine of Wisdom (Starlight Atoll)
triggers.message: Crystalline spires hum with astral harmony on Starlight Atoll. Press [E] to meditate for the Blessing of Wisdom (+1 INT, +1 WIS, +4 Max MP to all party heroes).

triggers.name: Shrine of Swift Grace (Tempest Reef)
triggers.message: Wind-carved coral pillars sing in the sea breeze on Tempest Reef. Press [E] to receive the Blessing of Swift Grace (+1 DEX, +2 Max HP, +2 Max MP to all party heroes).

triggers.name: Gilgamesh's Tavern & Adventurers' Guild
triggers.message: Gilgamesh raises a tankard: 'Press [E] to manage your Roster and Party!'

triggers.name: The Royal Armory & Provisions
triggers.message: Blacksmith Gareth nods: 'Blades, plate, torches, and potions forged for the realm! Press [E] to trade.'

triggers.name: The Wayfarer's Inn
triggers.message: Innkeeper Mara smiles: 'Warm beds and hearty stew! Press [E] to rest and save your game.'

triggers.name: Temple of the Triad
triggers.message: High Priestess Seraphina chants softly: 'The Triad restores the fallen. Press [E] for a blessing.'

triggers.name: Fountain of Valor
triggers.message: Crystal-clear water sparkles in Oakhaven's central fountain.

triggers.name: Royal Herald of Avalon
triggers.message: Herald: 'Malakor the Lich Lord corrupts the Cavern of Despise, and Pyrothrax rules the Abyss of Doom!'

triggers.name: Veteran Scout
triggers.message: Scout: 'Never enter a dungeon without Lumina Orb or Pitch Torches! Darkness blinds your view and invites ambushes.'

triggers.name: Court Mage
triggers.message: Mage: 'Thieves can pick locked dungeon doors and disarm chest traps, or a Wizard can cast Arcane Knock!'

triggers.name: Gate Guard
triggers.message: Guard: 'Step off the town's outer border or press [X] at any time to return to the Overworld.'

triggers.name: Rangers' Lodge & Guild
triggers.message: Guildmaster Elion greets you: 'Press [E] to reorganize your party or recruit from the Roster.'

triggers.name: Yew Bowyer & Outfitter
triggers.message: Fletcher Lyra polishes an ash longbow: 'Fine bows, brigandine, and elven cloaks! Press [E] to trade.'

triggers.name: The Mossy Bough Inn
triggers.message: The scent of pine and roasted roots fills the air. Press [E] to rest your party.

triggers.name: Druid Circle of Yew
triggers.message: Ancient standing stones hum with divine magic. Press [E] to receive a woodland blessing.

triggers.name: Elder Druid
triggers.message: Druid: 'Clerics and Paladins can invoke Triad Sight to sense floor traps and treasure chests in the deep caverns.'

triggers.name: Elven Pathfinder
triggers.message: Pathfinder: 'East across the mountains lies the Cavern of Despise, where the Lich Malakor hoards ancient relics.'

triggers.name: Moon Harbor Dock & Skiff Charter
triggers.message: Harbor Master Corwin waves from the pier: 'Press [E] to charter a shallow-draft Skiff (150 GP) to sail the coastal shallows and reach the Island Shrines!'

triggers.name: The Rusty Anchor Guildhall
triggers.message: Captain Vance grins: 'Press [E] to inspect your Roster or swap party members!'

triggers.name: Moon Quartermaster
triggers.message: Quartermaster: 'Crossbows, arcane rods, skeleton keys, and sea-salts in stock! Press [E] to trade.'

triggers.name: Harborview Inn
triggers.message: The sound of waves lulls weary sailors to sleep. Press [E] to rest your party.

triggers.name: Shrine of the Tides
triggers.message: Sea-priests chant hymns to the Triad. Press [E] for a blessing.

triggers.name: Old Mariner
triggers.message: Mariner: 'South across the stone bridge lies the volcanic Abyss of Doom — twelve floors of wyrms, dragons, and dread!'

triggers.name: Astrologer
triggers.message: Astrologer: 'Ethereal Recall will pull your party out of the deepest dungeon floor straight to Oakhaven!'
